model: Host configured default; actual model identifier unavailable in CLI output; no override

method: Eight synthetic cases, direct and root variants, batched into one no-tool process per host and phase. Every case was instructed to be independent. Guidance and discovery frontmatter were supplied in the prompt; expected outcomes were withheld. readFiles are model-proposed/reported choices, not observed local filesystem reads. No autoload/discovery or automatic reference-loading behavior is established.
timeProvenance: Collection bounds from prompt creation and extracted response modification times; response extraction may follow model completion.
limitations: Single batched sample per host/phase; no statistical or latency/token conclusion.
After input includes extracted conditional lifecycle/enrichment guidance; model-noted unsupplied examples remain proposed reads.
No live tool schemas, real effects, OAuth, Workspace read or persisted product proof.
